rows.jp: 「そろそろ行きます」
rows.en: “I'd better get going.”

ghs.en: Miki: "I should be going by now."

rows.jp: 「うむ」
rows.en: “Mm-hm.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Uh-huh."

rows.jp: 「あ、そうです」
rows.en: “Oh, right.”

ghs.en: Miki: "Ah, yes."

rows.jp: 立ち去ろうとした美希が、振り向いた。
rows.en: Miki turned back just as she was about to leave.

ghs.en: Departing Miki turns around.

rows.jp: 「みみ先輩、部活再開したって、知ってます？」
rows.en: “Did you know Mimi started club activities again?”

ghs.en: Miki: "Mimi-senpai is resuming club activities, did you know?"

rows.jp: 「へー」
rows.en: “Oh?”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Huh..."

rows.jp: 例のアンテナの件だな。
rows.en: It had to be about that antenna.

ghs.en: The matter of that antenna, was it.

rows.jp: 知らないフリしとかないとな。
rows.en: Better pretend I didn't know.

ghs.en: I should just feign ignorance now.

rows.jp: 「平和維持活動じゃなくて……ええと、友貴がやってる生命維持部とは別に？」
rows.en: “Not peacekeeping... um, is this separate from Tomoki’s Life-Support Club?”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Is that separate from... not the Peace-keeping Operation... uhm, the Life Maintenance Club that Tomoki's doing?"

rows.jp: 「いや、放送部の……ほら、ラジオ局の」
rows.en: “No, the Broadcasting Club... You know, the radio station.”

ghs.en: Miki: "Well, it's the Broadcast Club's... come on, the Radio station thing."

rows.jp: 「ああ……コミュニティＦＭ局がどうたらってやつ？」
rows.en: “Oh... that Gunjo Community FM Station thing?”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Ahhh... from the Community FM station, is it that one?"

rows.jp: 「です」
rows.en: “That's it.”

ghs.en: Miki: "It is!"

rows.jp: 「いろいろあって中止になってたはずじゃあ？」
rows.en: “I thought it got called off after everything that happened.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "All that stuff happened so it should've been suspended, right?"

rows.jp: 「アンテナ、組み立ててましたよ？」
rows.en: “She was putting the antenna together.”

ghs.en: Miki: "She was still putting that antenna together you know?"

rows.jp: 「うわ、あぶねー」
rows.en: “Yikes. That's dangerous.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Whoa, that's daaangerous."

rows.jp: 途中まで組まれていたとはいえ。
rows.en: Granted, it was already partly assembled.

ghs.en: Though it needs be said it was assembled partway.

rows.jp: 「脚立使ってよちよちやってました」
rows.en: “She was tottering around on a stepladder.”

ghs.en: Miki: "She was toddling around, using that stepladder."

rows.jp: 「よちよちって……」
rows.en: “Tottering...?”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Toddling, you say..."

rows.jp: 「そんくらい危なっかしかったんです」
rows.en: “That's how dangerous she looked.”

ghs.en: Miki: "She looked about that dangerously unsteady."

rows.jp: 「……あー、ショックだったのかなやっぱ」
rows.en: “...Yeah. Guess it really hit her hard after all.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "...ahhh, you were trying to shock me into acting then."

rows.jp: 「でしょうねぇ」
rows.en: “Probably.”

ghs.en: Miki: "Wasn't I."

rows.jp: 俺たちは顔を見合わせて、力なく笑った。
rows.en: We looked at each other and shared a weak laugh.

ghs.en: We looked at each other's faces and smiled without strength.

rows.jp: 「お互い、頑張って生きていきましょう」
rows.en: “Let’s both try to keep on living.”

ghs.en: Miki: "Let's reciprocally do our best to live."

rows.jp: 「だな」
rows.en: “Yeah.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Yup, let's."

rows.jp: 「自分が可愛いですしねー」
rows.en: “We’re awfully fond of ourselves, after all.”

ghs.en: Miki: "Because you gotta think of yourself as precious!"

rows.jp: 「んじゃ」
rows.en: “Later.”

ghs.en: Miki: "So then."

rows.jp: すちゃ、と片手をあげて、美希は去った。
rows.en: Miki raised one hand in a quick salute and left.

ghs.en: And with a single raised hand as if snapping to attention, Miki left.

rows.jp: 「しかし、部活ねぇ」
rows.en: “A club, huh.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "But still, club activities, huh..."
